title: Start creative Lux sessions on latest main automatically
body:
Every normal start-lux request selects verified latest main automatically under the user's standing authorization, without another upgrade approval. Preserve user work and the isolated creative profile.

Acceptance:
- Resolve latest main for first and later starts. Reuse a matching reservation without restart.
- Use existing launcher commands; do not invent an upgrade flag.
- Preserve source, assets, links, controls, playback, profile and library data. Check restore support before stopping a live session.
- Require a clean reserved checkout; stop only the verified creative PID. Retain rollback, align dependencies, update reservation, rebuild and verify live connection.
- Preserve development/test isolation. Install/check the shipped start-lux skill after review and integration.
reason: Correct the originally misrecorded user requirement; the reviewed source already implements automatic normal starts.
